svg.title: Trips by public transport between two points, departure by departure
svg.desc: Thirty horizontal stacked bars, one per departure minute from 14:00 to 14:29, from Farroupilha Park to PUCRS in Porto Alegre: walk to the stop, wait, ride, transfer and walk from the stop, with the routes taken and the total time at the end of each bar. Totals range between about 30 and 40 minutes; the wait changes most from minute to minute, and the routes change as earlier buses are missed.

stroke-width: 0.9; stroke: none; fill: #FFFDF9;
stroke-width: 0.9; stroke: none;
